description: This Java class handles the deletion of loan collateral management entries, acting as a command handler in the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the delete operation to a service based on a command pattern.

classes.name: DeleteLoanCollateralManagement
classes.description: Handles delete commands for loan collateral management; implements command processing and delegates to the service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the deleteLoanCollateral method of the service.
